name: Jeremy Twogood
summary: Multimedia producer and video editor with 20 years of broadcast, documentary, and corporate production experience. Editor of 8,000+ broadcast and web deliverables across entertainment, sports, business, and current affairs — never missed a broadcast deadline. Proven across enterprise clients including Shell, Microsoft, NS Health, and CAOT. Integrates AI-assisted workflows for scripting, captioning, and asset management to accelerate delivery without sacrificing craft.

generative_ai: Google AI Studio (image and music generation)

experience.title: Segment Producer, Editor, and Camera Operator
bullets: Edited more than 8,000 broadcast and web deliverables across entertainment, arts, music, comedy, film, celebrity interviews, lifestyle, local business features, technology, sports, auto, and current affairs — never missed a broadcast deadline across 18 years.

Led company-wide migration from Adobe Creative Suite to Final Cut Pro X and Motion — trained staff, rebuilt workflows, and eliminated per-seat licensing costs, saving approximately $50,000 over 14 years.

Delivered complete broadcast packages end-to-end on daily deadlines — sourcing footage via EPKs, B-roll research, and self-shot phone and drone content; cutting raw rushes into story-driven segments with minimal direction; and finishing with titles, motion graphics, VFX, music, sound design, and colour grading.

Functioned as story editor, writer, and producer on many segments — shaping large unstructured footage piles into clear narratives, and writing tags, chyrons, titles, and full scripts from scratch when needed.

Edited interviews with musicians, comedians, filmmakers, and entrepreneurs into broadcast-ready segments, researching and sourcing supplementary material to build context and narrative around each subject.

Produced and edited lifestyle segments featuring Toronto-area businesses — restaurants, food trucks, nature resorts, and local venues — delivering complete brand stories with location B-roll, company narrative, and interview material.
Developed press conference questions for TIFF junkets that generated international coverage — Christian Bale, Matt Damon.
Maintained 100% core team retention over 18 years through deliberate workplace culture initiatives.

experience.title: Freelance Producer, Editor, Colourist, and Drone Operator
bullets: Enterprise and institutional clients across energy, healthcare, finance, government, and technology sectors: Shell, Penske, Nova Scotia Health, Ewing Morris Investment Partners, the Canadian Association of Occupational Therapists, Xbox and Microsoft, and the Oak Ridges Moraine Groundwater Program.
Long-form and documentary work including a 20-video bilingual series (CAOT) and a feature documentary on Indigenous public art (Journeyman Video Production / Shell).
Multi-camera post-production for Houseplant (Seth Rogen, Evan Goldberg) — synced and media-managed a large 4K multi-cam, multi-mic shoot across multiple locations in Vancouver.
Corporate video partner with Journeyman Video Production, Canova Media, and BizMedia; aerial drone operator on the Xbox Forza 5 campaign (BizMedia).
Full-service delivery: scripting, directing, editing, colour, motion graphics, and multi-platform versioning.

experience.title: Co-Creator, Producer, and Editor
bullets: Co-created and produced a Toronto restaurant documentary series with a team of three video producers — shooting, editing, and delivering 5–10 broadcast-quality features on local chefs and restaurant operations.
Interview subjects include Chef Nuit Regular (Pai Northern Thai Kitchen) and Zane Caplansky. 12 episodes, 350,000+ views.

experience.title: Freelance Video Editor
bullets: Edited corporate training videos for a Toronto-based production company specializing in workplace and instructional content.

Large-scale internal productions for AstraZeneca and recruitment video for Bishop Strachan School.
